gc.zuchtgrenze.title: Breeding limit (Mod)
gc.zuchtgrenze.short: GC mod: more animals per area before breeding stops; animals on leashes count less.
gc.zuchtgrenze.body:
Valheim stops [[valheim.tame.breeding|breeding]] as soon as too many animals of a kind stand together. This mod raises the limit ([[gc.zuchtgrenze.breed]]); with [[gc.tiere|GC_Tiere]] animals on a leash or at a post count only partly.

All values are [[gc.serverrules|server rules]]. [[gc.kern.stufe|Level]] 4 “GC light”; while on, the mod adds 1 % per boss to the [[gc.kern.bossscale|boss progression]].

gc.zuchtgrenze.breed.title: Breeding limit
gc.zuchtgrenze.breed.short: How many animals of a kind may stand nearby before none of them gets pregnant any more. Currently {gc_zuchtgrenze_breed}.
gc.zuchtgrenze.breed.body:
Valheim counts adults and young of the same kind nearby, wild ones too, and only allows offspring below a limit per species, such as 4 wolves within 10 m. Here:

- Limit: {gc_zuchtgrenze_breed_factor} Valheim's value, range: {gc_zuchtgrenze_breed_radius} Valheim's value
- An animal on a leash or at a post counts {gc_zuchtgrenze_breed_leashed} (with GC_Tiere).
- Chickens count hens and laid eggs, not chicks, with their own values: limit {gc_zuchtgrenze_breed_chicken_factor} and range {gc_zuchtgrenze_breed_chicken_radius} Valheim's value, a hen on a leash counts {gc_zuchtgrenze_breed_chicken_leashed}.

Off: exactly as in Valheim. The limits per species are written to the server log at start.
